# CityMETER · Hotel

> Recorded hotel rooms and accommodation records across Thailand by district (เขต/อำเภอ), with straight-line distance to rail stations (CityMETER Transit) and retail venues (CityMETER Shopping centers), hotel groups, recorded prices and a comparison set per hotel. A Landometer CityMETER public demo, release 0.3.9 (2026-11-08). Research master checked 2026-11-08.

What one figure means:
- rooms = Σ rooms_selected, the room count the sources record. Not rooms available per night, occupancy, demand, ADR or revenue. Unknown rooms are counted apart, never as 0.
- records (แห่ง) = source-listed accommodation records (CityMETER Hotel V3, TAT accommodation register, official group and property pages, provincial lists). Operation is not revalidated; not a census.
- recorded prices = min/max/avg THB recorded by CityMETER Hotel V3, source period unknown. Per hotel only.
- distances = straight lines between reference points, not walking routes or catchments.
- districts = CityMETER production districts (codes as in https://landometer.com/v3/citymeter/{province}/D/{district}?d=hotel).
- names (0.3.4) = a record the research sheet links to the brand that operates it now, whose recorded name carries none of the brand's words, reads under the name the brand lists on its own site (data.currentNames, with link and date); the recorded name stays as “ชื่อที่บันทึก” and in search.
- sites (0.3.6–0.3.8) = the drawn buildings inside a stay's research site boundary (49_SITE_BOUNDARY_CHECK, checked: 282 stays, 4,150 buildings), published as one interior point per building (data.siteGroups); opening the stay shows and frames them together (“ทั้งรีสอร์ท N อาคาร”). The boundary comes from Department of Lands parcel outlines (three Karon resorts, 0.3.6) or an OpenStreetMap area of the stay's own — checked with the stay's own site layout (twelve stays, 0.3.7–0.3.8) or, since 0.3.8, checked automatically with no layout yet (267 stays in 50 provinces; the page reads “กรอบ OpenStreetMap (ตรวจอัตโนมัติ)” and links the OSM element) — © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0; parcel shapes, deed numbers, title areas and the OSM frames are not published, and a site is not a land title or ownership.

Snapshot (release 0.3.9, figures unchanged since 0.3.1; fixtures, recompute from data):
- 30,729 records, 1,033,157 rooms recorded (30,650 records with known rooms), 860 of 928 districts, 77 provinces.
- Bangkok: 35% of the province's recorded rooms (53,516 of 153,200) are in Khlong Toei, Watthana and Ratchathewi; 67% of their rooms with a point lie within 500 m of an operating rail station, against 42% in the rest of Bangkok.
- The district with the most rooms recorded: Bang Lamung, Chon Buri (62,561).

Deep links (https://montri-th.github.io/hotel/):
- ?metric=count — measure records instead of rooms
- ?province={code} — e.g. BKK, PKT, CBI (production codes)
- ?area={district code} — e.g. 1039 (เขตวัฒนา)
- ?areas={code},{code} | ?areas=all — focus districts / every district
- ?group={hotel|resort|apartment|guesthouse|bungalow|homestay|other} · ?size={s1…s6} · ?chain={group id | none}
- ?hotel={record id} · ?station={CityMETER Transit station id} · ?view={areas|mix|chains} · ?search={text}

Data and method:
- [Product statement](https://montri-th.github.io/hotel/PRODUCT_STATEMENT.md): users, problem, claim boundary
- [Data and method](https://montri-th.github.io/hotel/DATA_METHOD.md): sources, measures, district matching, context joins, limits
- [Dataset](https://montri-th.github.io/hotel/data/hotels.json): columnar rows + dictionaries + provenance (meta)
- [Developer handoff](https://montri-th.github.io/hotel/handoff/START_HERE.md)

Map reading (0.3.0): symbol area grows with recorded rooms (hollow = unknown); names near the middle of the view rank by recorded rooms and recorded price; chain logos identify brands; terrain facts (ground elevation, relief, sea within a ring, OSM tree cover) describe the ground, never a view; buildings stand on the terrain at hilly sites. Buildings per area: CityMETER Building V4 in each local administration (Bangkok: each khet) where it holds at least 1.15 × the OpenStreetMap buildings, else OpenStreetMap; OSM buildings mapped in parts are kept; CityMETER heights are model estimates (data/building-units/).

Building view (0.3.2): choosing a stay with a point opens a two-point perspective of a 3D building — the drawn building whose outline holds the pin, else the drawn building nearest the pin within 300 m (800 m when nothing is drawn within 300 m), labelled “อาคารใกล้หมุด”. The nearest building is a camera choice, not a claim that the stay is in it.

Ask Google (0.3.3): every view links to a Google Search for the question of the view (Google answers it at the top with an AI Overview; its AI Mode tab continues). Google's answers are not CityMETER data and are never copied into it.

Do not claim from this data: occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, revenue, demand, market share, current prices, that a hotel is open today, star ratings, walking time, that a district without records has no hotels, or that a building height is measured (CityMETER heights are model estimates).
